## New features

- Added canvas rulers and document guides. Drag guides from either ruler, enter exact positions, lock them or undo changes. Optional snapping aligns pasted content and moved selections.
- Added ruler appearance settings for fonts, colours and opacity. Vertical labels are compact and right-aligned, with intermediate tick marks. Backgrounds default to 75% opacity. Rulers are off by default.
- Added automatic monitor-refresh detection and a custom frame-rate limit.

## Fixes and improvements

- HEIC and HEIF now use installed system codecs instead of a bundled decoder and export pack. Preferences shows opening and saving support separately. Unsupported transparency or precision produces an error instead of silently losing information. Related to issue 196.
- Line previews and undo remain attached to the original layer and mask when switching or reordering layers.
- GPU preferences apply at startup and show the adapter actually in use, including fallback status. Related to issue 202.
- Frame limiting preserves mouse and pen input samples, while stationary paste previews can go idle. Related to issue 203.
- Preferences and Recent Files tooltips no longer repeat fully visible text. Related to issue 204.

Guides are saved in PFE5 projects and excluded from image exports. These projects require the new release or newer. Related to issue 206.
